### Vision
Alumni Association serves as a link to a symbiotic relationship between institution and former graduates.

### Mission
1. Establishing and strengthening a long term relationship with our Alumni, engaging alumni in the continuing branding of institute.
2.  Connecting existing alumni with the institute & bridge the gap of communication between alumni and existing students.
3. Developing students with global competence via alumni Connect.
